title: Applying for leave fails with 500 'Self-service request failed' - no active leave policy is seeded and the validation surfaces as a server error
url: /me (Apply for leave), POST /api/me apply_leave, POST /api/attendance-leave request_leave
steps: On /me fill Leave type CL, From/To tomorrow, reason
expected: Pending leave request created (balance checked), or an honest 'leave policy not configured' 4xx
actual: HTTP 500 {error:'Self-service request failed'}; serve.log: 'Active leave policy configuration is required' (leave_policies is empty in the seed). Same for manager request_leave (500 'Attendance/leave update failed'). Client-side empty-form validation works ('Fill leave type, dates and a reason (4+ chars).'). Leave apply->approve journey and same-person self-approval check therefore not completable.
